title: Contact Us
summary: How to reach CampusEduX for support, privacy, billing and legal matters.
intro: We are happy to help. Please email the address that best matches your question and include your registered email or mobile number so we can find your account.
We aim to acknowledge emails within {{supportResponseBusinessDays}} business days.

sections.heading: Support
body: {{supportEmail}} — account help, projects, jobs, placement prep, resume builder, technical issues and general questions.

sections.heading: Billing and refunds
body: {{supportEmail}} — payments, Premium, wallet, and refund requests. Include the order ID from Purchase History. See the Refund & Cancellation Policy for what is eligible.

sections.heading: Privacy and account deletion
body: {{privacyEmail}} — questions about your data, exercising your rights, or requesting account deletion if you cannot use the app. We will not ask for your password by email.

sections.heading: Grievance Officer
body: In line with Indian law, you can raise a grievance with our Grievance Officer:

sections.heading: Legal and copyright
body: {{legalEmail}} — copyright complaints, licensing questions, and legal notices.

sections.heading: Help inside the app
body: The Help & Support screen has answers to common questions, and the Legal & Privacy section has all of our policies.
